name: Relm CRM
description: An API-first CRM built for LLMs and AI agents. Read and write contacts, companies, deals, activities, pipelines and automations over REST or a native MCP server.

oauth2.description: OAuth 2.1 with PKCE and dynamic client registration. Recommended for end-user agents.

scopes.crm: Read and write the connected Relm workspace

bearer.description: Workspace API key (relm_live_... or relm_test_...) minted at https://app.relmcrm.com/

skills.name: Manage contacts
skills.description: Create, find, update and delete people. Email-optional; email is unique per workspace.

skills.name: Manage companies
skills.description: Create and link accounts; contacts and deals reference them.

skills.name: Manage deals
skills.description: Open opportunities and move them across pipeline stages.

skills.name: Log activities
skills.description: Record notes, calls, emails and meetings, with backdating.

skills.name: Automations
skills.description: Create event-triggered rules and drip sequences, including send-email.

skills.name: Webhooks
skills.description: Subscribe an https endpoint to CRM events; deliveries are HMAC-signed and retried.

skills.name: Describe schema
skills.description: Read the live object/field/enum registry so writes are never based on a guess.
